prompts: Draw a tiny map of your favorite imaginary neighborhood.
Write a three-line poem about coffee and scissors.
Sketch a logo for an imaginary craft club.
Cut a shape out of paper without planning it, then build a creature around it.
Draw the person across the table without looking at your paper once.
Invent a flag for the table you're sitting at. It needs exactly two colors.
Illustrate a sound you can hear right now.
Design the packaging for a snack that does not exist yet.
Fill a page with one repeated mark until it stops feeling like a chore.
Draw your morning as a single continuous line.
Write a very short instruction manual for something you already know how to do.
Make a collage self-portrait using only text you cut from a page.
Sketch the ugliest possible chair, then make it look expensive.
Draw a plant that only grows indoors, in coffee shops, in winter.
